page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing predictable compute performance. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This hardware profile does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents an entry-level GPU-accelerated option. The combination of a legacy NVIDIA P4 GPU and modest network bandwidth makes it a budget-conscious choice for workloads that require hardware acceleration but do not demand the throughput of modern GPU architectures. Suitable workloads include low-concurrency inference, basic video transcoding, and lightweight CUDA-based development or testing.
